P.name: Deathbringer Stance
P.title: Template:Data Aatrox/Deathbringer Stance
P.wikitext:
{{#vardefine:i_hmod|1.0}}{{#vardefine:i_mhmod|0.25}}{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Deathbringer Stance|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Aatrox |skill = I |icon = Deathbringer Stance.png |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Aatrox''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|4 to 10}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|100 to 320}} against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Deathbringer Stance's'' damage applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

'''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for the {{tt|post-mitigation '''bonus''' damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|{{#var:i_mhmod}}*{{#var:i_hmod}}*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}. |description2 = Whenever '''Aatrox''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} with a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or an {{tip|ability}}, ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 2 seconds, doubled to 4 if he hits with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of ''{{ai|The Darkin Blade|Aatrox}}''. |static = {{pplevel|22 to 10}} |targeting = Passive |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = magic |spellshield = False |spelleffects = proc |parry = True |notes = * '''Aatrox''' will assume stance when an enemy champion is in range of {{ai|Infernal Chains|Aatrox}}. ** The [[Emoting|toggle]] expression (default {{sbc|CTRL + 5}}) switches between stances manually. * If ''Deathbringer Stance'' becomes available during a standard attack's windup, it will not be consumed or trigger the '''bonus''' damage. * Even if the ability hit is {{tip|spell shield|spell shielded}} ''Deathbringer Stance's'' cooldown will still be reduced. * This ability goes on cooldown on death and refreshes upon respawn. * The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}. |blurbicon = Deathbringer Stance.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Aatrox}} next {{tip|basic attack}} deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{as|{{sti|healing}}}} him for the damage dealt. |blurb2 = '''Aatrox's''' basic attacks and {{tip|ability}} hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} {{sti|ah|reduce}} ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|cd|cooldown}}. }}

Q.name: The Darkin Blade
Q.title: Template:Data Aatrox/The Darkin Blade
Q.wikitext:
<!--Edit these paramater values when they get changed
-->{{#vardefine:b1|10}}<!--First Cast base damage Rank 1
-->{{#vardefine:b2|70}}<!--First Cast base damage Rank 5
-->{{#vardefine:r1|60}}<!--First Cast rank 1 AD ratio as a PERCENTAGE 
-->{{#vardefine:r2|90}}<!--First Cast rank 5 AD ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:cd|0.25}}<!-- Bonus Damage Modifier per Cast as a DECIMAL
-->{{#vardefine:sd|1.75}}<!--Total Sweetspot Damage as a DECIMAL
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|The Darkin Blade|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Aatrox
|name         = The Darkin Blade
|skill        = Q
|icon         = false
|description  = '''Aatrox''' can activate ''The Darkin Blade'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' performs a strike with his greatsword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit within an area. Enemies hit within a {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of the area take {{ccs|{{#expr:({{#var:sd}}-1)*100}}% '''bonus''' damage|physical}} and are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Each subsequent cast gains {{ap|{{#var:cd}}*100}}% more damage.
|icon3        = The Darkin Blade.png
|description3 = {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' first strike affects a 625{{times}}180-unit rectangular area in the target direction, with him centered on the back line and the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge.
|leveling3    = {{st|First Cast Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b2}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}} to {{#var:r2}}}}% AD)}}|First Sweetspot Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:b2}}*{{#var:sd}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:r2}}*{{#var:sd}}}}% AD)}}}}
|icon4        = The Darkin Blade 2.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' second strike affects a trapezoidal area in the target direction, with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge. The hitbox begins 100-units behind '''Aatrox''' and extends 475-units in front of him, measuring between 300 and 500-units wide from behind to in front.
|leveling4    = {{st|Second Cast Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}) to {{#var:b2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}) to {{#var:r2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}})}}% AD)}}|Second Sweetspot Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}})*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:b2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}})*{{#var:sd}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}})*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:r2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}})*{{#var:sd}}}}% AD)}}}}
|icon5        = The Darkin Blade 3.png
|description5 = {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' third strike affects a 300-radius circular area centered on a target location that is 200 units in front of him, with a 180-radius {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} within.
|leveling5    = {{st|Third Cast Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2) to {{#var:b2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2) to {{#var:r2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)}}% AD)}}|Third Sweetspot Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:b2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)*{{#var:sd}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:r2}}*(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)*{{#var:sd}}}}% AD)}}}}
|description6 = ''The Darkin Blade'' deals {{pp|55 to 70|key=%|1;6;11;16|formula=55% base + 5% every 5 levels thereafter}} damage against {{tip|minions}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, the first cast deals {{as|25 '''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by the subsequent cast and {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} damage modifiers; and the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration from hitting the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} against them is doubled to {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
|leveling6    = {{st<!--
-->|Maximum Non-Minion Non-Sweetspot Damage|<!--
-->{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)) to {{#var:b2}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2))}} <!--
-->{{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2)) to {{#var:r2}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2))}}% AD)}}<!--
-->|Maximum Non-Minion Sweetspot Damage|<!--
-->{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2))*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:b2}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2))*{{#var:sd}}}} <!--
-->{{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r1}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2))*{{#var:sd}} to {{#var:r2}}*(1+(1+{{#var:cd}})+(1+{{#var:cd}}*2))*{{#var:sd}}}}% AD)}}}}
|range        = Varied
|effect radius= Varied
|cast time    = {{fd|0.6}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|14 to 6}}
|cdstart      = Cooldown starts on first cast and restarts on each successive recast
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|notes        = 
* [[File:Aatrox hitbox areas.png|thumb|The highlighted areas denote the sweetspot - enemies are affected where the two areas overlap (See {{tip|er|edge range}} and {{tip|cr|center range}}).]] The first and second casts function like any point-blank AOE (i.e. an effect centered on the caster). An enemy is considered to be hit by the ability based on {{tip|er|edge range}} - i.e. if any part of your {{tip|gameplay radius}} is within the hitbox, you are affected.
* The third cast, as well as the {{as|Sweetspot}} for the first and second cast, function like [[ground-targeted]] abilities. An enemy is considered to be hit by the ability based on {{tip|cr|center range}} - i.e. an enemy's center has to be within the hitbox to be affected.
* As implied by the previous point, the {{as|Sweetspot}} for the first and second cast is implemented as separate [[area of effect|areas of effect]] to the main component of the ability. Enemies must be within both areas to trigger the bonus damage, {{tip|airborne|knock up}} and {{ais|Deathbringer Stance|Aatrox}} cooldown reduction.
** The 'target gets hit' SFX plays whenever an enemy is within the {{as|Sweetspot}} - meaning it is possible to trigger the sound effect without affecting an enemy.
* In the game, {{as|Sweetspot}} damage is incorrectly displayed as [[File:Critical strike physical icon.png|20px|link=]] a real critical strike.{{bug|1}}
* Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The hitbox and '''Aatrox's''' model are fixed to the initial target direction.
** '''Aatrox's''' facing-direction, for effects such as {{ai|Petrifying Gaze|Cassiopeia}}, is the direction he is moving, and not the direction the model is facing.
* All damage modifiers {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|stack multiplicatively}}.
* There's a small period of time in which Aatrox can't declare basic attacks after casting ''The Darkin Blade''.{{bug|2}}
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''The Darkin Blade'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Aatrox''' if he moves during the cast time.
{{ct|cast|cast= {{ai|E|Aatrox}} can be cast. Other abilities are disabled.|interrupts=death}}
<!-- Blurb-->
|blurbicon    = The Darkin Blade.png
|blurb        = {{ci|Aatrox}} can cast this ability up to three times in a short amount of time before it goes on {{sti|cooldown}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' performs an attack with his greatsword in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within an area. The area varies and the damage increases per cast. Enemies within each area's {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} receive increased damage and are briefly {{tip|airborne|knocked up}}.
* [[File: The Darkin Blade.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Aatrox''' strikes his greatsword in a long rectangle. 
* [[File: The Darkin Blade 2.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Aatrox''' slashes his greatsword in a wide trapezoid. 
* [[File: The Darkin Blade 3.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Aatrox''' slams his greatsword in a circle.
}}
